n, b = map(int, input().split())
array = [0] * (n + 1)
oddCountPrefix = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCountPrefix = [0] * (n + 1)

inputLine = list(map(int, input().split()))
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    array[i] = inputLine[i - 1]
    if array[i] % 2 == 1:
        oddCountPrefix[i] = oddCountPrefix[i - 1] + 1
        evenCountPrefix[i] = evenCountPrefix[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCountPrefix[i] = oddCountPrefix[i - 1]
        evenCountPrefix[i] = evenCountPrefix[i - 1] + 1

cuts = 0
diffArray = []
for i in range(2, n, 2):
    if oddCountPrefix[i] == evenCountPrefix[i]:
        diffArray.append(abs(array[i] - array[i + 1]))
    else:
        diffArray.append(-1)

diffArray.sort()
total = 0
for val in diffArray:
    if val != -1 and total + val <= b:
        cuts += 1
        total += val

print(cuts)
